summary: Keep visible terminal tab activity even in a one-cell strip

replay.detail: No replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: Each split keeps a transient tab-strip view offset; workspace data is unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Every nonempty strip keeps an activity glyph on each painted agent tab. Overflow markers, the add button and other tabs yield when necessary. Selection-following keeps the active tab visible; manual scrolling may intentionally hide it. Covered at widths 1 through 20, counts 1 through 60, and every initial offset and active index.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes. Wheel over a tab strip to browse it; selecting another tab reveals it if needed.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
